method: Primary-source public web opens and targeted literature queries; no new numerical assets acquired. No exhaustive novelty claim.
queries: Brutsaert1975 clear-sky emissivity; all-sky longwave diffuse cloud correction

sources.assessment: NOAA describes independent shortwave/longwave instruments, auxiliary meteorology and public quality-controlled daily products.
Brutsaert clear-sky effective emissivity is established physical parameterization; cloud extensions must be disclosed as empirical.

Published all-sky longwave work compares vapor-state formulations and cloud increases in downwelling irradiance; our families are source-aware reproductions/extensions, not first principles newly found.

novelty_disposition: Not established. Predictive extensions or informative falsifications require independent literature and domain review.
